notes.title: Foxlore January/Febraury Devlog (RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!)
notes.content:
Foxlore January/Febraury Devlog (RELEASE DATE!)
A lot has happened over the past couple months, I can hardly believe it.
Over the past couple of months, we've hit major milestones! These include completion of the game's OST, Completion of the game's coding and dialogue implementation (Now in the private debugging phase, QA tests will begin soon.), and nearing completion of the new art! Along with this, there has been a new game banner created!

Game OST Completion!
Our wonderful Luci Sheppy has completed the Foxlore OST! You can order it before the game goes live, it currently contains 13 tracks and you can get it for €7!

https://lucisheppy.bandcamp.com/album/foxlore-original-game-soundtrack

Art & Coding Completion!
We've been working hard over the past few months to maximize quality and speed in terms of production. Our official sprite artist Antiiconoclasm is pretty much done, and here's a few peeks at his work that will be in the game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/01fb6c01ff4b5cc4088de6650706391fbca655e6.png

(I'd show off the coding I've been doing, but it's not nearly as visually impressive. Just giant blocks of text.)

New Game Library Hero
A special thanks to @lianarozza on Telegram for this amazing work of art - to be featured as the game's Library Hero!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/bcb00b472b2accd88983791add3aaa9337484f88.png



THE LONG AWAITED FOXLORE RELEASE DATE
Well, let's play a game... We'll call this the release date announcement. Everything you need is in the following two lines, can you decode it? If so, mention me @nikolarsson on Twitter or post it in the Official Discord!

32 31 3 5
1gy12hf074haps713s0hax29ndx03hamgbau3x3ahfolwdni

If you can't solve it, that's okay. I'll be announcing it in the upcoming Full Release trailer later this month / early April, so stay tuned for that!

As always...
Thank you all for your continued support! As always for any questions, comments, or concerns my DM's are always open on any of my socials and I am the most active on Discord. You can find the official links here:

🔗 https://discord.gg/AmV2xrZsVt

notes.title: Foxlore December Devlog
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you've had a wonderful month full of holidays!

I'll start out with the big news: We are rapidly approaching the end of development! 

As per the tentative roadmap shared in the November devlog, this month has been filled with hard work from myself along with the Foxlore team! Puzzles have officially been completed and implementation & translation of dialogue is expected to be completed within the coming weeks. Exciting!

Given this news, you can expect a release date announcement in the next devlog! Now, here's a just a slice of what I've been working on over the past month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/a12c369fbe9bcc172afeea383a4d8807c254d12a.png

Puzzles are done, you say?

Yup! While there will still be some refining to be done in the QA phase, puzzles are done! On top of this, it comes with new puzzle mechanics such as the ability to draw on puzzles! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/ec7103628fdd2273a339969532af08ab252dd8a3.gif

Let There Be Light!

In addition to everything else, I've been hard at work creating and implementing a lighting system that improves the look of the game while still retaining the atmosphere. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/0df270e86555d16842aed142d5618e65886905c6.gif

In closing...

A lot of major announcements are right around the corner. I'm excited to share what we've made with you all, and I can honestly say that if this were a game I played, I would enjoy it. Thank you all for your continued support. As always for any questions, comments, or concerns my DM's are always open on any of my socials and I am the most active on Discord. You can find the official links here:

🔗 https://discord.gg/AmV2xrZsVt
🔗 https://linktr.ee/nikoviant

notes.title: Foxlore November Devlog
notes.content:
Foxlore's Demo & Nextfest was a success!
Over 1,000 users have claimed the Foxlore Demo! Wow, that's a lot of you!

Thanks to everyone for their support of the demo! This was an amazing opportunity to see people's first impressions of the game, the game mechanics, the art, and so much more! Additionally, shoutout to my QA testing group. Thanks to them, the demo was released with minimal speedbumps.

The ultimate point of the demo was to see the following things first-hand, given this is my first game:

What gameplay and puzzle mechanics players like best.
How to best walk the player through the story.
What players look for in dialogue.


The information that I've gained from this experience is being implemented into the entire game. A lot of game mechanics have been changed based on player feedback, and I believe the game has become something truly great already!

Streaming Development
In order to get some marketing going for the game, I'm going to be streaming parts of development. Some parts will be left out to avoid serious spoilers. You can follow me on Twitch here:
https://www.twitch.tv/nikoviant

General Roadmap
To start off, I'm going to start posting devlogs on a monthly basis to make sure there is a common place for news to be communicated other than the discord server! Additionally I have recieved a couple people asking where we are on the map since the Kickstarter launched this summer:

Here's the general to-do list:
[olist]
[strike]Conceptual development[/strike]
[strike]Kickstarter start[/strike]
[strike]Kickstarter finish[/strike]
[strike]Full World design and art[/strike]
[strike]Base programming & mechanics[/strike]
[strike]Foxlore Demo[/strike]
[strike]Foxlore Next-Fest[/strike]
[strike]Optimize coding & mechanics based on player feedback[/strike]
Complete puzzle set (We are here!)
Implement revised and TRANSLATED dialogue (Translators apply in the Discord!)
Complete Foxlore (QA Testing)
Marketing (Release date will be announced here.)
Release Foxlore (Kickstarters will recieve their keys via email here.)
[/olist]

Woah, we're getting pretty close to the end!

As always, thank you all for the support. If you ever want to contact me, you can do so personally via any of my socials found at https://linktr.ee/nikoviant or join the Foxlore Discord Server (https://discord.gg/AmV2xrZsVt) where I am fairly active. See you next month!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/a2c2365e603c6ec3f96e8b583d9c266099141fc2.png

Foxlore's Kickstarter has officially concluded successfully!

Foxlore's Kickstarter was a huge success! And by huge, I mean we over TRIPLED our funding goal! 🎉

I want to thank everyone who contributed, I really appreciate it! Thanks to your contributions, the Steam fees, Gamemaker license, and cover art have been covered! Along with this, the rest is going towards OST development and other areas to make Foxlore a great game.

I want to thank particularly Mark "Angus Cormac" Leonard and "Kiwibro" for having the largest pledges!

Devlog #1 - Map Design
With the success of the Kickstarter, I'd like to drop the first devlog for Foxlore! I've been committed working hard on the game between college and work. And it's been coming along really smoothly!

Map design has been the biggest focus over the past few months. I want to make sure that the art and the environment are consistent and quality. I want to make the world feel like it is alive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/ffcdf9e4de0577da5d3fb5ab9a7c9b5f3fbfae68.gif
Functional mirror, as an example of creating immersive gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/0290358692f112b4b1fa64a3ff9ea24de836677a.gif
Scurrying mice, as an example of creating the feeling the world is alive.

Foxlore has a semi-open world model for its exterior areas. The point of the game is to explore and find clues to solve the mysteries that unfold as Filo goes on his adventure. While there is a linear objective-line to the story, you'll miss out on a lot if you don't stray from it a bit and explore!

I also want to ensure that the game accurately reflects the environment of the Midwest/rust belt area. While the game takes place in a fictional world, this is definitely the heart of inspiration for the game's atmosphere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041232/04476efb807dd1caad7a341be6c0d7c5d805c56f.png
Filo approaching the gas station/convince store.

Overall, I've had a great time designing the maps for Foxlore and I'm excited that i've moved on to coding interactions and cutscenes. After this stage is completed, I can move into marketing and then get a firm release date!

Thanks again to everyone for supporting my first game!

Psst... Join the official Foxlore Discord HERE: https://discord.gg/AmV2xrZsVt
